svg.title: Conditional probability as restricting to the evidence
svg.desc: Two overlapping events a and b. Conditioning on b keeps only the b region; P(a|b) is the share of b that also lies in a.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: Conditioning on b: keep only the b region, then rescale
